title: Window Mode / Initial Position Type settings ignored
body:
### Tested versions

-Tested in on-going projects, and fresh projects. 
-Tested in X11, and Wayland
-Tested in Godot 4.4.beta3 and Godot 4.4.beta2
-Tested on Godot 4.4Beta 2 on a Kubuntu 18, and did not have this issue, but did once moving to UbuntuStudio 24. Both are KDE desktop environments. And both (can) use X11

### System information

Godot v4.4.beta3 - Ubuntu (UbuntuStudio) 24.04.1 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 6600 (RADV NAVI23) - AMD Ryzen 7 5700X 8-Core Processor (16 threads)

### Issue description

(This is on a fresh UbuntuStudio 24 OS install.  Wiped and installed fresh last week, no changes made, essentially all defaults)

On a multi-monitor setup, without using the embedded game workspace, and opening in a fresh independent window, initial window type is ignored. Whether I set it to Center of Primary Screen, or Center or Other Screen, the setting is ignored, and the project always opens on the screen where Godot is running.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/896f3adf-0ebe-44fd-bbb5-64e24adaac97

### Steps to reproduce

Cycle the settings for initial window position in a multi-monitor setup, and run the game. Although I'm assuming something about UbuntuStudio/KDE may be to blame? You can change between X11 and Wayland at login, and I've tested on both with the same issue. But didn't have this issue on previous versions on Kubuntu.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

No MRP needed. This happens on a fresh project. Make a scene and hit play.
